main_subject.description: An adult woman with ash-blonde shoulder-length hair, a relaxed expression, and over-ear headphones.
main_subject.wardrobe: A white crew-neck T-shirt, light full-length trousers, white socks, and plain canvas sneakers; a gray cardigan rests over the bench back.
main_subject.pose_and_expression: Sitting comfortably on a rustic wooden park bench, looking down at an open blank-cover blue book.

composition_elements.setting: Lush summer park beneath drooping willow branches, with a calm pond, stone paving, and an unbranded blank canvas tote beside the subject.
composition_elements.framing: Wide full-body natural candid framing from eye level, placing the subject within the larger park.
composition_elements.text_and_brand_control: No uploaded pose/face requirement, tote slogan, book text, logo, or watermark.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Warm dappled afternoon sun filtering through leaves, controlled contrast and natural highlights.
lighting_and_atmosphere.mood: Peaceful, academic, solitary, summery, and narratively gentle.

technical_specs.rendering: Rich greens, subtle grain, realistic pond reflections, natural skin, accurate hands, and soft distant background.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:5 vertical Superia-inspired 35mm park lifestyle portrait of an adult woman with ash-blonde shoulder-length hair, a relaxed expression, and over-ear headphones. She wears a white crew-neck T-shirt, light full-length trousers, white socks, and plain canvas sneakers; a gray cardigan rests over the bench back. Seat her comfortably on a rustic wood bench beneath drooping willow branches, looking down at an open blank-cover blue book. Include a calm pond, stone paving, and an unbranded blank canvas tote beside her. Use wide eye-level full-body candid framing, warm dappled afternoon sun, controlled natural contrast, rich greens, subtle grain, realistic pond reflections, natural skin, accurate hands, and soft distant background. No uploaded pose/face requirement, tote slogan, book text, logo, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, exact identity lock, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, shorts, readable text, logo, tote slogan, watermark, distorted hands, AI artifacts

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Identity and pose references are optional and must depict a consenting adult. All clothing, tote, book, and park references are replaceable and must be stripped of branding and text.
